hints.title: Initial Greedy Target
hints.text: The optimal set of k positive integers starts with 1 through k, summing to k * (k + 1) // 2.

hints.title: Overlapping Numbers
hints.text: If any number in nums is less than or equal to the current upper threshold, that number cannot be appended, pushing our threshold up by 1.

hints.title: Deduplicated Inspection
hints.text: Sort unique elements of nums. Whenever an element x <= k is encountered, subtract x from our sum and add k + 1, then increment k.

hints.title: Arithmetic Sum Adjustment

variables: n: number of elements in nums
complexity.notes: Sorting unique elements dominates the runtime.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating integer addition step-by-step TLEs for k up to 10^9.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Set of unique elements uses O(n) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate uses mathematical summation and handles threshold expansion.
